name: Logger Pro
product: Logger Pro 3 by Vernier Science Education

evidence.says: Vernier dates the final 3.16.2 update to March 5, 2021 and provides the Mac updater.
Vernier has ended development and new license sales and confirms version 3.16.2 is final.
Vernier identifies the final Mac release as Intel-compiled and confirms it runs under Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon, with feature limitations.

notes: Vernier split the product's features across its Analysis apps, and existing customers can still access installers.

name: Barcode
product: Barcode Generator by Appsforlife

evidence.says: Appsforlife dates Barcode 2.7.3 to August 31, 2026 and offers separate downloads for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

notes: The vendor also keeps Barcode 1 available as a legacy download.

name: VMwareGfx
product: VMwareGfx video-driver kernel extension (VMware Tools)

evidence.says: The VMware Tools 12.5.0 manual identifies the exact bundle ID as the VMware video-driver kernel extension.

notes: Part of VMware Tools for macOS guest VMs.

name: ShortcutDetective
product: ShortcutDetective by Irradiated Software

evidence.says: Irradiated Software still offers version 1.0 for Mac OS X 10.6 or later.
The guide reports that ShortcutDetective is no longer updated, its final version has no Apple Silicon code, and Homebrew removed the unmaintained cask in 2026.

limitation: Runtime on recent macOS versions was not verified.

name: Mu Editor
product: Mu Editor by the Mu project

evidence.says: The official repository explicitly says the project is no longer maintained.
The archived project marks v1.2.0 as its latest release.

limitation: Final macOS package architecture was not verified.

name: teamlogger
product: TeamLogger Timer (Build80)

evidence.says: The vendor lists separate Mac installers for Intel and Apple Silicon.
The vendor release manifest identifies the Apple Silicon installer as teamlogger-3.19.41-arm64.dmg.

name: NFC Tools for Desktop
product: NFC Tools for Desktop by Wakdev

evidence.says: Wakdev identifies 2.7 as current and publishes separate ARM Mac and Intel Mac disk images.

notes: This verification covers Wakdev's direct ARM download.

name: YesPlayMusic
product: YesPlayMusic, original Electron edition (qier222)

evidence.says: The developer calls 3.0 a new app, leaves the old code on the 1.x branch, and explicitly says the old version will receive no further updates.
The final Electron release lists a separately named YesPlayMusic-mac-0.4.10-arm64.dmg.
The project published the last Electron release, 0.4.10, on October 9, 2025.

notes: The final Electron release had a native Apple Silicon build. The developer replaced it with an Apple Silicon-only Flutter rewrite starting at 3.0.0, with different streaming features.

name: SnapGene Viewer
product: SnapGene Viewer standalone (GSL Biotech, now Dotmatics)

evidence.says: SnapGene support names 7.2.1 as the last separate Viewer and documents the merger into the main app in 8.0.
The vendor now offers the main SnapGene app from its Viewer download page.

limitation: Architecture of the final standalone Viewer 7.2.1 remains unverified.
notes: Starting with 8.0, the paid and free editions share one SnapGene binary, which runs in Viewer mode without a license.

name: Dialpad
product: Dialpad desktop communications app by Dialpad

evidence.says: Dialpad offers separate Apple Chip and Intel Chip downloads for the main Dialpad app.
The live Homebrew cask ties version 2610.1.0 to Dialpad's official /osx/arm64/dialpad.pkg URL and identifies a separate x64 installer.

name: Filen Sync
product: Filen desktop sync client by Filen Cloud Dienste

evidence.says: Filen distributes separate Apple Silicon and Intel macOS downloads for its desktop sync client.
The live cask gives Filen's official CDN package Filen_mac_arm64.dmg under versioned path v3.0.55.
The vendor lists v3.0.55 among its official desktop releases.

notes: The desktop client is now branded Filen.

name: LSwitch
product: LSwitch for LIFX by George Trigonakis

evidence.says: The developer identifies LSwitch as a macOS menu bar app for LIFX lighting.
The Mac App Store lists 1.2 dated March 18, 2016, and does not specify its architecture.
The historical submitted scan identifies com.gtrigonakis.LIFXSwitch version 1.2, build 11, with a 64-bit Intel executable only.

limitation: The matched version has a submitted Intel scan. Rosetta runtime and the current App Store file were not independently tested.

name: ABDialer
product: ABDialer by Macron Software

evidence.says: A 2004 first-hand user report identifies ABDialer as a Mac OS X shareware dialer and names its historical Macron Software product URL.

limitation: No live official release, current architecture or Apple Silicon runtime evidence was found.

name: Apache NetBeans 12.6
product: Apache NetBeans 12.6 by the Apache Software Foundation

evidence.says: Apache dates 12.6 to November 29, 2021 and identifies the macOS installer.
Apache explicitly says older releases are no longer supported and lists 32 as the current release.
The 12.6 macOS disk image remains available as a 412 MB historical archive.

limitation: The architecture of the archived 12.6 macOS launcher was not verified.
notes: This disposition applies to the version-specific 12.6 bundle. The Apache NetBeans IDE remains active.

name: Fluor
product: Fluor by Pierre Tacchi (Pyroh)

evidence.says: The developer labels the latest release Fluor 2.5.1 for Apple Silicon and published it July 6, 2022.

name: MapMap
product: MapMap projection mapping by the MapMap team

evidence.says: The MapMap team released 1.0.0-beta.1 on November 23, 2026 and offers a macOS disk image for both Intel and Apple Silicon.

notes: The current official Mac build is a public beta.

name: gSwitch
product: gSwitch (Cody Schrank)

evidence.says: The maintainer archived the project and explicitly ended development and support following the move to Apple Silicon.
The official 1.9.7 release ZIP contains gSwitch.app/Contents/MacOS/gSwitch, inspected as x86_64 only.

notes: The final main executable is Intel x86_64 only. Its discrete GPU switching feature applies to older dual-GPU MacBook Pros.

name: A Better Finder Attributes 6
product: A Better Finder Attributes 6 (publicspace.net)

evidence.says: The vendor still distributes 6.25 as a legacy download. Its A Better Finder Attributes 6.app/Contents/MacOS/A Better Finder Attributes 6 main executable is x86_64 only.
The version 6 changelog identifies 6.25 and dates its release to September 23, 2020.
Publicspace identifies version 7.03 as the first built for Apple Silicon.

limitation: Version 6.25 was inspected but Rosetta operation was not confirmed.
notes: Version 7 is a separate major release. Native Apple Silicon support first arrived in 7.03.

name: 8BitDo Firmware Updater
product: 8BitDo Firmware Updater by 8BitDo

evidence.says: 8BitDo provides the standalone Firmware Updater for macOS under its Upgrade Tool page.
Inspection of 2.5.2 in this vendor ZIP found x86_64 and arm64 slices in 8BitDo Firmware Updater.app/Contents/MacOS/8BitDo Firmware Updater, with bundle ID com.8bitdo.firmwareupdater.

notes: This is the standalone utility for controller and receiver firmware.

name: StatusClock
product: Status Clock (Pulsely Consulting Limited)

evidence.says: Pulsely explicitly documents native M1 and M2 support for 1.4.1 and lists the current 1.6.0 version on June 4, 2023 without an architecture statement.

limitation: The release notes confirm native support for 1.4.1, while the current 1.6.0 Mac App Store build has no first-party architecture specification.

name: Home Anywhere Computer
product: Home Anywhere Computer (AnB Rimex SA)

evidence.says: Software Informer describes the AnB Rimex home automation setup application of the same name.

limitation: No current Mac release, version or architecture was verified.
notes: A third-party listing identifies the home automation product and vendor, but its 1.17 entry does not verify the scanned Mac build.

name: Yippy
product: Yippy clipboard manager by Matthew Davidson

evidence.says: The official Yippy.zip for version 2.8.1 contains Yippy.app/Contents/MacOS/Yippy, which file reports is x86_64 only, and Info.plist matches MatthewDavidson.Yippy.
Homebrew identifies the 2.8.1 Mac cask as Intel and states that it requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.

limitation: Runtime was not tested independently.
notes: The cask is disabled for Gatekeeper reasons.

name: BitTorrent Web
product: BitTorrent Web for Mac by BitTorrent Limited

evidence.says: The official product page identifies BitTorrent Web for macOS.
The app's official Sparkle feed advertises build 6575 of version 1.6.0 dated September 14, 2026.
The ZIP contains BitTorrent Web.app/Contents/MacOS/BitTorrent Web, which file identifies as x86_64 and arm64, and Info.plist confirms com.bitTorrent.btweb and version 1.6.0 build 6575.

notes: The separately inspected official support installer contains universal version 1.4.0; this record uses the newer official update.

name: iRightMouse
product: iRightMouse (Better365 / Ningbo Shangguan Technology)

evidence.says: Apple lookup supplies the exact bundle ID, release date and developer notes that explicitly confirm native Apple M-series and Intel support for 2.5.1.

notes: This is the Mac App Store edition with the exact scanned bundle ID.

name: Cisdem ContactsMate
product: Cisdem ContactsMate for Mac by Cisdem

evidence.says: Cisdem lists 6.8.1 on August 16, 2024 as the most recent Mac release.
Inspection of Cisdem ContactsMate.app/Contents/MacOS/Cisdem ContactsMate in the vendor disk image found x86_64 and arm64 slices and bundle ID com.cisdem.contactsmate in version 6.8.1.

name: SandollCloud
product: SandollCloud desktop font manager by Sandoll

evidence.says: Sandoll distributes the desktop font manager from its Mac OS download control.
Inspection of SandollCloud.app/Contents/MacOS/SandollCloud in the vendor disk image found x86_64 and arm64 slices and bundle ID kr.co.sandoll.SandollCloud in version 5.2.1, build 71.

name: Yubico Authenticator
product: Yubico Authenticator by Yubico

evidence.says: Yubico dates version 7.5.0 to October 28, 2026 and identifies the newer 7.5.1 as Windows-only.
Inspection of Yubico Authenticator.app/Contents/MacOS/Yubico Authenticator in the official disk image found x86_64 and arm64 slices and bundle ID com.yubico.yubioath in version 7.5.0.

name: Red Alert
product: OpenRA – Red Alert by the OpenRA project

evidence.says: OpenRA identifies release-20250330 as the current stable version and provides a Mac disk image.
The project published the stable release on March 30, 2025.
The tagged Mac packaging script compiles the launcher for x86_64 and arm64, bundles the arm64 runtime, and packages OpenRA – Red Alert.app in the disk image.

notes: This is the separately launchable OpenRA Red Alert mod bundled in the official Mac disk image.

name: Wizard Pro
product: Wizard Pro 1.x (Evan Miller)

evidence.says: The store lists 1.9.49 as the current version and release notes document fixing model estimation on Apple M1 in 1.9.46.
The exact 1.9.49 Wizard Pro scan identifies only the X86 architecture.

limitation: Rosetta compatibility is based on the vendor’s M1 release note and the submitted architecture scan, without a new runtime test of 1.9.49.
notes: Wizard 2 is a separate product.

name: Epochulator
product: Epochulator unix time calculator (Doug Everly)

evidence.says: The catalog identifies Doug Everly’s Mac app as a developer tool for Unix timestamp conversion and cannot confirm current download availability.
The legacy 1.3 submission reports X86 only.

limitation: No current official distribution was found. The architecture of a currently available release cannot be established.
notes: Apple lookup by the exact bundle ID returned zero results.

name: Agatha Christie - Hercule Poirot The First Cases
product: Agatha Christie – Hercule Poirot: The First Cases, Mac App Store edition (Microids / Blazing Griffin)

evidence.says: Apple identifies the exact bundle ID and advertises 1.0 without specifying architecture.
The two legacy scans report X86 and ARM in 1.0.0 but only X86 in 1.0.3.

limitation: Apple markets the current download as 1.0. It could not be tied to either of the conflicting scanned binaries.
notes: The legacy 1.0.0 submission reports a universal binary and 1.0.3 reports x86 only.

name: Pavtube ByteCopy
product: Pavtube ByteCopy for Mac (Pavtube Studio)

evidence.says: The legacy Pavtube product page identifies ByteCopy for Mac as the disc copying and conversion app.
The surviving download page lists old Mac operating systems for ByteCopy with no Apple Silicon or architecture detail.
The catalog describes an older Mac edition and links to a download host that could not be reached.

limitation: The publisher download could not be retrieved, and the surviving product pages do not identify a current Mac build or its architecture.
notes: The separate Windows ByteCopy release does not establish the Mac version.

name: I2P
product: I2P Easy Install Bundle for Mac by the I2P Project

evidence.says: The latest tagged release of the standalone Mac installer offers separate arm64 and x86_64 disk images for I2P 2.7.0.
Inspection of I2P.app/Contents/MacOS/I2P found an arm64 executable with bundle ID net.i2p.router in version i2p-2.7.0.
The project documents a separate installation path using the Java router JAR.

notes: The version and architecture refer to the standalone Mac app bundle recorded in the audit, which trails the current Java router.

name: Deliveries
product: Deliveries for Mac by Junecloud

evidence.says: Junecloud identifies the current Mac version as 9.7 and lists Apple Silicon updates in the older 9.1 release notes.
The Mac App Store lists Junecloud's macOS app but omits the CPU architecture of the executable.
Junecloud records the Mac release of Deliveries 9.7 on October 5, 2026.

limitation: The older Apple Silicon compatibility note does not establish the CPU architecture of the current 9.7 Mac release.

name: CreateDiskImage
product: CreateDiskImage by Andreas Kiel (Spherico)

evidence.says: Developer Andreas Kiel identifies CreateDiskImage as his standalone Mac utility for creating and managing disk images.
The historical scan ties the Spherico bundle ID to an Intel executable from version 1.0, build 1.0.2.

limitation: The developer's website and disk image did not load, and current distribution or maintenance status could not be established.

name: CDRViewer Pro
product: CDRViewer Pro standalone Mac edition by Iconshots (Bluetail)

evidence.says: The vendor describes the older CDRViewer Pro and now promotes the free CDRViewer listing and newer Pro options.
Apple's live lookup returns zero Mac App Store results for the exact standalone CDRViewer Pro bundle ID.
The historical scan identifies version 1.0, build 124 of the exact standalone bundle as Intel.

limitation: The final standalone Pro version and its architecture could not be established.
notes: The current Bluetail CDRViewer sells a Pro in-app purchase under a separate App Store listing.

name: Clevershare
product: Clevershare wireless screen-sharing client by Clevertouch and CVTE

evidence.says: The vendor's download page links the macOS Clevershare 5.14.1 build 7882 disk image.
Inspection of Clevershare.app/Contents/MacOS/Clevershare_MAC found x86_64 and arm64 slices, and the bundle Info.plist confirmed com.cvte.clevershare.mac and version 5.14.1.

name: Mocha Pro 2020.5
product: Mocha Pro standalone by Boris FX (formerly Imagineer Systems)

evidence.says: Boris FX's 2026.5.1 release notes specify Apple M1 ARM64 hardware and list Apple silicon in standalone macOS requirements.
Boris FX announced native Apple M1 support in the earlier Mocha Pro 2022 release.
Boris FX identifies 2020.5 as an older release of the same Mocha Pro product.

limitation: Architecture of the original scanned 2020.5 standalone build was not independently verified.
notes: Update the stale display name to Mocha Pro if the listing tracks the current product.

name: Firestorm
product: Phoenix Firestorm Viewer for Second Life, Havok edition, by the Firestorm Project

evidence.says: The official source tag forces both arm64 and x86_64 for Darwin builds.
The download index identifies the official 7.2.5.81788 Mac Second Life Havok disk image as universal and links the vendor's x64-named asset.
The independent release overview reports the public 7.2.5.81788 release on October 26, 2026, Second Life time.

limitation: The shipped disk image is over 150 MB and was not inspected.
notes: The x64 filename and stale Homebrew version alone are misleading. This row concerns the Havok edition indicated by the bundle ID.

name: SilverFast 8
product: SilverFast 8 scanner software by LaserSoft Imaging

evidence.says: The SilverFast 8 product guide specifies Intel Mac only.
LaserSoft documents ARM support via Rosetta 2 on macOS Monterey and flags scanner models that need 64-bit drivers.
LaserSoft still offers SilverFast 8 downloads and updates to registered users.

limitation: The latest patch build and compatibility of individual scanner drivers were not verified.
